title.narrative: Lao PDR - Protection and Services for Vulnerable settlements, Migrants and Youth in Savannakhet and Champassak

description.narrative: Lao PDR has implemented an effective strategy to contain COVID-19 outbreak. With the first two cases detected on 24 March 2020, the country has reported 45 cases and zero deaths to date. However, while the Government has introduced several measures to prevent the spread of the virus, the full scope of the pandemic in Lao PDR is still unknown. Basic social services and protection are likely to see the impact of Lao PDR’s stagnant economic growth, and structural pre-existing vulnerabilities may augment the impact of stressors such as the pandemic. The vulnerability of households with limited access to basic services and good hygiene practices is likely to be further exacerbated in this context. UN-Habitat had developled a vulnerability mapping model on COVID-19 highlighting the at-risk communities. The United Nations in Lao PDR, under the leadership of the Resident Coordinator, has been engaged in discussions with the UN Country Team (UNCT) to provide support in the most vulnerable areas. After securing MPTF funds to provide assistance at border crossings and quarantine facilities, UN-Habitat has engaged with UNFPA and IOM to move a step forward towards providing mid-term assistance to the most vulnerable in disadvantaged settlements. The data sources have been been sufficiently utilized to inform the design of this project; National poverty indexes and relevant administrative data, SDG report, Joint project report, Village assessment results reports, IOM surveys, MoH annual report
